name: Engine M3: 2D stage (assets, image, text, shape, group nodes)
description: Builds the 2D MotionNodes on Pixi v8 directly (no @pixi/react): image, text, shape and group, plus image asset loading, visibility windows and the createNode dispatcher the runtime uses. Drawing is checked later on the lab page (M7).

stories.title: isVisible: the layer time window
stories.description: As a runtime author, I want one pure visibility rule so that layers appear and disappear on exact times with no tween tricks.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md section 'Visibility' and the idea in tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src/components/PixiSequence/PixiSequence.tsx (do not copy its tweens).
Create engine/src/pixi/visibility.ts exporting isVisible(timeSec, start, end, docDuration).
Create engine/src/pixi/visibility.test.ts.
acceptance: isVisible(1, 1, 2, 6) is true, isVisible(2, 1, 2, 6) is false, isVisible(0.999, 1, 2, 6) is false
isVisible(6, 0, 6, 6) is true (last frame) and isVisible(6, 0, 5, 6) is false

stories.title: loadImageAssets with per-asset errors
stories.description: As a runtime author, I want all image assets loaded in parallel with failures reported per asset so that one broken image does not stop the doc.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md section 'Assets' and tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src/utils/loadSpriteTexture.ts.

Create engine/src/pixi/assets.ts exporting loadImageAssets(doc, load?) and unloadImageAssets(doc, unload?), where load defaults to Assets.load from pixi.js and is injectable for tests; gltf assets are skipped.
Create engine/src/pixi/assets.test.ts with an injected fake loader (one success, one rejection, one gltf asset).
acceptance: With assets { a: image ok, b: image failing, c: gltf }, textures has only 'a', errors has one entry with assetId 'b', and the loader was called twice
Both images are requested before either resolves (the loader is called for both before the first promise settles)

stories.title: shapeNode: rect and ellipse with fill tweens
stories.description: As an author, I want rectangles and ellipses with an animatable fill so that I can build cards, bars and backgrounds.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md sections 'The MotionNode contract', 'Base transform' and 'Node types', and engine/src/core/transform.ts.

Create engine/src/pixi/nodes/shapeNode.ts exporting createShapeNode: NodeFactory. Draw with Graphics (roundRect when radius > 0, ellipse centred in the width x height box), fill and optional stroke; size() is width x height; apply applyBaseTransform; ready resolves at once.
resolveTarget: undefined target -> resolveBaseTarget, plus 'fill' as a colour TargetRef whose setColor redraws the Graphics; anything else -> null.
start and end are absolute: parentStart + layer.start and parentStart + layer.end.
Create engine/src/pixi/nodes/shapeNode.test.ts (real pixi.js Graphics in jsdom).
acceptance: A rect layer 200x100 at x 300, y 200 with anchor [0.5, 0.5] gives display position (300, 200), pivot (100, 50) and size() { width: 200, height: 100 }
resolveTarget(undefined, 'fill') returns kind 'color' and getColor() returns the layer's fill; setColor('#ff0000') then getColor() returns '#ff0000'
With parentStart 2 and layer start 1, end 3 the node's start is 3 and end is 5

stories.title: imageNode: sprite sized from the layer, tint tweens, missing texture
stories.description: As an author, I want image layers sized by width or height with the aspect kept so that plates and cut-outs drop in correctly.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md 'Node types' (image row and the missing texture paragraph).

Create engine/src/pixi/nodes/imageNode.ts exporting createImageNode: NodeFactory using ctx.textures.get(layer.asset); size from width/height with the aspect kept when one is missing; natural size when neither; tint from the layer; 'tint' colour target in addition to base targets.
When the texture is missing: display is an empty Container, size() is { width: 0, height: 0 }, and ready rejects with Error('motion: image asset <id> did not load').

Create engine/src/pixi/nodes/imageNode.test.ts with a Texture made from a small canvas-free source (for example new Texture({ source: new TextureSource({ width: 400, height: 200 }) }) or Texture.WHITE scaled), whichever works in jsdom.
acceptance: For a 400x200 texture, layer width 200 gives a 200x100 sprite; layer height 50 gives 100x50; neither gives 400x200
resolveTarget(undefined, 'tint') returns a colour ref that changes the sprite's tint
A layer whose asset has no texture gives a node whose ready rejects with a message containing the asset id, and creating it does not throw

stories.title: textStyleFrom and textNode with font loading
stories.description: As an author, I want text layers with stroke, shadow, wrap and alignment so that titles and captions look designed.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md 'Node types' (text row, textStyleFrom and Fonts paragraphs) and tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src/utils/textStyleV8.ts.

Create engine/src/pixi/nodes/textStyle.ts exporting textStyleFrom(style) returning Pixi v8 TextStyleOptions (stroke object, dropShadow with angle in radians, wordWrap when wordWrapWidth is set, align, lineHeight, letterSpacing).

Create engine/src/pixi/nodes/textNode.ts exporting createTextNode: NodeFactory. The Text object is created inside ready after document.fonts.load for the first family (skipped when document.fonts is missing or rejects); until then display is an empty Container that the Text is added to. size() is the Text's measured size (0x0 before ready). Targets: base plus 'fill' (colour).
Create engine/src/pixi/nodes/textStyle.test.ts (pure; do not construct Text in jsdom).
acceptance: textStyleFrom({ fontSize: 80, stroke: { color: '#000000', width: 4 }, wordWrapWidth: 600 }) returns fontSize 80, stroke { color: '#000000', width: 4 }, wordWrap true, wordWrapWidth 600
dropShadow angle 90 maps to Math.PI / 2 and alpha, blur and distance pass through
textNode.ts compiles under strict TypeScript and is exercised in the browser by m7 (record in notes that text drawing is browser-verified only)

stories.title: groupNode and createNode dispatcher
stories.description: As a runtime author, I want one createNode call that builds any 2D layer, including nested groups with offset times, and accepts a three factory from outside.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md sections 'Node types' (group row) and 'createNode'.

Create engine/src/pixi/nodes/groupNode.ts exporting createGroupNode(layer, ctx, parentStart, create) that builds children with create(child, ctx, absoluteStart), adds their displays in order, pivot 0, size() from the union of children's local bounds, ready = Promise.all of children (rejecting if any rejects), destroy destroys children.

Create engine/src/pixi/createNode.ts exporting createNode(layer, ctx, parentStart = 0, factories?) dispatching on type; three uses factories.three; a missing factory throws Error('motion: no node factory for <type>').
Create engine/src/pixi/index.ts re-exporting isVisible, loadImageAssets, unloadImageAssets, createNode, the four factories and textStyleFrom.
Create engine/src/pixi/createNode.test.ts with a nested group of shapes and a fake three factory.
acceptance: A group starting at 2 with a child shape starting at 1 gives a child node with start 3; a grandchild in a nested group starting at 0.5 inside it gets start 3.5
The group's display has its children's displays in layer order
createNode on a three layer without factories.three throws an error naming 'three'; with a fake factory it returns that factory's node
Destroying the group calls destroy on every child node (spied)
